message.content:
**A — Mobile Home**

1. **FIRST IMPRESSION**
The eye lands on the warm terracotta hero and search bar, then drifts down a long, magazine-like scroll that feels calm but slightly cluttered in its lower sections.

2. **WHAT WORKS**
- The hero section with the 1px hairline input fields against the photographic background creates a premium, uncluttered entry point with clear hierarchy.
- Experience cards use the bone band (#ECEAE6) effectively as a container, with consistent 16-24px rounded corners and mustard stars that pop without competing with the primary accent.
- The “Coast. Desert. Wild.” editorial block with the gradient scrim feels like a well-composed magazine spread, using whitespace and typography scale (H2 at ~28px) to create breathing room.

3. **ISSUES**

| Severity | Principle Broken | Concrete Fix |
|----------|------------------|--------------|
| **MUST FIX** | One-accent rule violated — multiple terracotta elements compete (“Search” CTA, “Browse all experiences,” “Try the planner,” “List your experiences,” plus red “1 issue” badge on Detail page) | Allow **one** terracotta CTA per view (the primary action). Secondary CTAs must be charcoal outlines or bone-filled buttons with charcoal text. The “1 issue” badge must change from #C4552D to charcoal #2D2D2D or bone #ECEAE6 with dark text. |
| **MUST FIX** | Touch targets under 44px — filter chips (“Desert,” “Coast,” “Wildlife,” etc.) appear to be ~32-36px height, failing mobile tap standards | Set all pill/chip heights to **44px min** with **24px horizontal padding** (8/16/24 scale). Font size inside: **12px uppercase label** or **14px small**, line-height 1.2. |
| **MUST FIX** | Spacing rhythm broken — vertical gaps between experience cards appear inconsistent (~12px in some places, ~20px in others) | Standardize card margins to **16px** between cards (or **24px** between sections). Section headers should have **48px** margin-top, **24px** margin-bottom. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Type scale violation — “The plan, step by step” and some body text appears below 16px (looks like 14px or 13px) | Enforce **body 16px** minimum for all readable content. Small text (**14px**) reserved only for metadata like “3 hours • Max 10.” Labels (**12px**) for tags only. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Image rounding inconsistency — hero image has no visible rounding (0px), while cards show ~16-24px; also the large “Swakopmund” feature image appears to have 0px rounding | Apply **border-radius: 24px** to **all** images including the hero background container and feature blocks. If full-width bleed is desired, use **border-radius: 0** consistently across all full-bleed images, but never mix 0px and 24px on the same view. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Contrast issue — terracotta #C4552D used for small text (“DEMO LISTING” labels) on white backgrounds fails WCAG AA for text under 18px | Change all small labels from terracotta to **charcoal #4A4A4A at 60% opacity** (or #777). Reserve #C4552D exclusively for the single primary CTA button or heading word (min 20px). |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Default/styled controls — date picker inputs show native browser styling (gray background, default calendar icon) | Style inputs with **1px solid #E0DDD8** border, **48px height**, **16px padding-left**, Poppins 16px, white background. Custom calendar icon in charcoal, not browser default. |
| **NICE TO HAVE** | Footprint motif missing or decorative-only — the logo mark is present but footprint trails are not used meaningfully to indicate progress/journey in the “Four steps” or “How it works” section | Replace generic numbered circles (01, 02, 03, 04) with **mustard #F2C240 footprint icons** (outline style, 24x24px) as step indicators, creating a visual trail down the page. |
| **NICE TO HAVE** | Shadow usage — subtle shadows visible on cards instead of strict 1px hairline borders | Remove all `box-shadow`. Use **border: 1px solid #E0DDD8** on all cards. For elevation on dark backgrounds (footer), use **border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)**. |

---

**B — Mobile Experience Detail**

1. **FIRST IMPRESSION**
The eye hits the bold H1 title and star rating, then follows the strong vertical image into a dense but well-structured content flow that feels informative yet slightly text-heavy.

2. **WHAT WORKS**
- The timeline component (“The plan, step by step”) uses the 1px border rule well with circular nodes, creating clear visual hierarchy for the itinerary.
- The “Included / Not included” checkmark/cross lists are scannable and use the bone background band effectively to group related information.
- Sticky-looking booking bar at bottom (with price and “Request to book”) provides good utility, though it needs refinement (see issues).

3. **ISSUES**

| Severity | Principle Broken | Concrete Fix |
|----------|------------------|--------------|
| **MUST FIX** | One-accent rule violated — “Request to book” button uses a pale terracotta/tan (#E8B89D or similar) that looks like a disabled state or secondary brand color, while “Ask on WhatsApp” is solid black, creating two loud actions | Make **“Request to book”** the **single terracotta #C4552D** button (full opacity, white text, 48px height, 24px radius). Make **“Ask on WhatsApp”** a **secondary outline button**: transparent background, 1px solid #2D2D2D, charcoal text. Remove any other colored buttons on this view. |
| **MUST FIX** | Touch target size — the “view 3” thumbnail and gallery dots, plus the close/dismiss controls on the image viewer, appear smaller than 44px | Gallery thumbnails: **56x56px min** with **8px spacing**. Pagination dots: **12px diameter** with **16px touch padding** (invisible hit area). All tappable icons (share, save): **44x44px** container. |
| **MUST FIX** | Horizontal overflow risk — the “What to bring” tag row (water layers, sun hat, etc.) may overflow viewport on narrow devices (320-375px) without scroll indication | Wrap tags in a **scrollable horizontal container** (`overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch`) with **padding-bottom: 8px** and invisible scrollbar, or stack them vertically with **8px gaps** if content is critical. Tags themselves: **height: 40px**, **padding: 0 16px**, **border-radius: 20px**, **border: 1px solid #E0DDD8**, **font-size: 14px**. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Type scale violation — “Highlights” H2 appears ~22-24px (should be 26-38px range); metadata like “3 hours” may be 13px | Set **H2 to 28px** (or 26px minimum), **line-height: 1.25**, **margin-bottom: 16px**. Metadata line: **14px**, **color: #777**, with **8px spacing** between icon and text. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Image aspect ratio — the hero dune image appears very tall (possibly >16:9), pushing content too far down (“above the fold” content is lost) | Constrain hero image to **aspect-ratio: 4/3** (for landscape) or **3/4** (for portrait) max-height **320px** on mobile, with **object-fit: cover** and **border-radius: 24px**. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | Operator avatar placeholder — the black circle with “ND” initials looks default/unstyled | Style as **64x64px circle** with **background: #ECEAE6** (bone), **charcoal text 24px bold**, **letter-spacing: -0.5px**, or replace with actual operator photo with **1px charcoal border** and **4px border-radius** (slightly rounded square per brand warmth). |
| **NICE TO HAVE** | Missing footprint motif — the timeline uses generic circles rather than the brand’s footprint trail to mark the journey steps | Replace timeline left-column circles (05:00, 06:00, etc.) with **small mustard #F2C240 footprint icons** (16x16px) or use footprints as the connecting vertical line decoration (dashed mustard line). |
| **NICE TO HAVE** | Copy tone — “absurd” in the review excerpt (“felt absurd until the sun came up”) is acceptable as user-generated content, but ensure all *editorial* copy avoids exclamation marks and hyperbole | Audit all GUIDR-written copy for exclamation marks. Ensure “Request to book” microcopy reads “Pick a date to continue” (current is fine). No “Book now!” energy. |

---

**CHECKLIST PASS COUNT: 9/15**

- [x] Focal point — Clear on both views (hero search / title)
- [ ] One loud accent — **FAIL**: Multiple terracotta/red elements per view
- [ ] Spacing on scale — **FAIL**: Inconsistent gaps, off-scale chip heights
- [ ] Type on scale — **FAIL**: Body text dipping below 16px, H2s undersized
- [x] Images rounded + cropped — Mostly pass, but hero/feature images need consistent 24px (currently mixed 0px and 24px)
- [ ] No default controls — **FAIL**: Native date pickers visible
- [x] Icons one family — Consistent line-weight icons observed
- [x] Max two shadows — Pass (using borders primarily)
- [x] Copy plain — Warm tone, no visible exclamation marks in UI copy
- [x] Mobile designed — Scrollable layout, appropriate widths
- [ ] States exist — **FAIL**: Cannot verify hover/focus/pressed states from static image (assume default)
- [ ] Contrast — **FAIL**: Terracotta on white for small labels
- [x] Purposeful motion — Not testable on static, but layout suggests parallax intent on hero
- [ ] Footprint meaningful — **FAIL**: Missing from process/journey sections where it would add semantic value
- [x] Removable-element test — Content appears structured in removable bands/modules
